sections.lead: The Moon just walked into Cancer, the sign of home, family and comfort, on Thanksgiving morning of all mornings. The sky is handing you a home-and-heart day.
items: Venus still sits exact on your natal Moon (0.1 deg): warmth, love and belonging at full strength
One watch-out: Mercury square your natal Mars tightened overnight, words can spark at the table
How to use it: lean into family and gratitude today, and keep hot-button topics off the dinner table
